title: Sessions reach their project Assistant; session cap holds on every open

requirements.text: genlock ask assistant "MSG" from a project session leaves a relay addressed to that project's own Assistant
The app delivers a project-Assistant relay to that project's Assistant, starting it if it is closed
The app refuses agent-initiated opens beyond the per-project cap, and still allows a handoff
genlock spinoff launch refuses at the cap before recording a launch
Project session rules name genlock ask assistant as the way to reach the Assistant

text: Done in code: genlock ask assistant + app routing (starts project Assistant if closed); cap in lib/cap.mjs used by open --prompt, Assistant open, spinoff launch; app backstop roomForAgentSession. Running app needs a relaunch to pick up the Swift side.

answers.observed: 583/583 node, 146/146 swift; cap=3 run failed exactly the 4 cap checks
answers.cause: nightmaremode's records show 37 swaps (in-tab) and 1 handoff, so the excess came from uncapped paths: Assistant open, spinoff launch, and the app opening whatever it was asked. That attribution is inferred, not logged
answers.absence: no app-side log of which path opened each of the 12; the Assistant's genlock open cap check has no CLI test, only the app backstop test
answers.assumption: user's own Cmd-N stays uncapped (my choice); a handoff counts as net zero because its asker closes at turn end
answers.falsify: in the relaunched app, with 4 nightmaremode sessions open, a Tally 'open nightmaremode' should be refused by genlock and, if forced, by the app banner
